entities.summary: "Last Night a D.J. Saved My Life" is a song written by Michael Cleveland, sung by American group Indeep, and released as a single in 1982 by Sound of New York and Becket Records. It features vocals from Réjane "Reggie" Magloire and Rose Marie Ramsey, and appears as the third track of the namesake album (1983). The single peaked at numbers ten and two on the US Billboard R&B/Hip-Hop Singles and Club Singles charts respectively.
